PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride

Portage, MI · Social

LGBTQ+Beginner friendly

PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride is a social group ride in Portage, MI. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm from Water Street Coffee (Portage). About 8–12 miles, party pace.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: party pace.
Check
Look at @pedalbicycles the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the PEDAL Tuesday Queer Ride group ride

A social, casual ride on paved trails hosted by the PEDAL bike shop. Everyone welcome, all bikes including e-bikes. Party pace, 8 to 12 miles. Last ride of 2026 was September 15.
